rv.q: Director Richard Baron has managed to beautifully curate a strong, heartfelt production that not only preserves the life of Nan, but also preserves something much bigger than that.
The result over the play's seventy-five minutes is a love letter to Shepherd that can only help her work to be discovered in pastures new.
